question: Find the total surface area of a cuboidal box whose length is 84 cm, breadth is 45 cm and height is 25 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area of Cuboid = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (84 × 45 + 45 × 25 + 25 × 84)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (3780 + 1125 + 2100)

⇒ TSA = 2 × 7005

**∴ The correct answer is 14,010 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) = 84 cm

Breadth (b) = 45 cm

Height (h) = 25 cm

 

 
• 
 
 

 
 

 
 l = 84 cm
 b = 45 cm
 h = 25 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base area (lb) = 84 × 45 = 3780 cm²

⇒ Side area (bh) = 45 × 25 = 1125 cm²

⇒ Front area (hl) = 25 × 84 = 2100 cm²

⇒ Sum of three distinct faces = 3780 + 1125 + 2100 = 7005 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 7005 = 14,010 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 14,010 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The volume represents the total 3D space occupied by the cuboid. Formula: V = l × b × h

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

LSA includes the area of the four side walls, excluding the top and bottom faces. Formula: LSA = 2h(l + b)

Length of Diagonal

The longest line segment that can be placed inside a cuboidal box is its diagonal. Formula: d = √(l² + b² + h²)
